scenes.caption: When money runs out, the wife offers to weave a beautiful cloth. She asks only one thing: he must never look inside while she works. Behind the closed door, the loom moves for nights. At dawn, she emerges weak, holding silk unlike anything he has seen.
scenes.emotional_turn: One forbidden room: gratitude becoming unease
scenes.visual_evidence: the wife presents gorgeous cloth with visibly trembling exhausted hands
required_visuals: pale wife holding brilliant woven fabric
